title: Perplexity Computer boosts productivity with 5 AI workflows that triple output #perplexitycomputer
description:
Perplexity Computer introduced five secret AI workflows that significantly boosted productivity by automating complex tasks. These workflows include a landing page generator, competitor intelligence tracker, sales preparation briefs, presentation slide creation, and contract review automation. 

By integrating pre-built templates that utilize the best AI models, Perplexity Computer enables users to complete tasks that traditionally took days within minutes, streamlining business processes and reducing the learning curve associated with multiple AI tools. This innovation offers substantial value for marketers, sales teams, legal professionals, and content creators seeking faster, more efficient workflows driven by AI.

The tool exemplifies how AI can consolidate various operational functions into one platform, making it a key solution in the evolving AI-driven productivity landscape.
